what: Trust-level totals of the ERIC 2025/26 site-data fields in config/mapping.yaml, computed independently of this Python code (JavaScript in a browser, reading the official CSV directly from files.digital.nhs.uk). The pipeline must reproduce these from the raw file.
method: Decode windows-1252; row 1 = field codes, row 2 = field names, rows 3+ = sites. Per trust: sum every value matching ^-?\d+(\.\d+)?$ ('Not Applicable' skipped), sums rounded to 6 dp, zero written as empty. n_energy_sites = sites with a numeric 'Gas consumed (kWh)'. gia_energy_reporting_m2 = floor area of those sites.

fixture.what: All 19 site rows for East Suffolk and North Essex NHS FT (RDE), the 15 identifier columns plus the 26 mapped fields, copied verbatim from the source file and re-encoded windows-1252 with CRLF line ends. sha256 of the UTF-8, LF version: 7b7a264ecb9ba1038002ba386b52e96dd19103e63c70fe934c710e59c26bd296

independent_totals: Per-trust total tCO2e (location and market) recomputed end to end in JavaScript from the raw site rows and the DESNZ values, with no shared code. The Python inventory must match to 0.001 t (1 kg).
